title: Oozy Norwegian Green Chilli Stew Donabe
description: Sour, chewy, romantic Norwegian dish featuring green chilli, lacquer-glaze, low-fat-friendly. Best served in a donabe vessel.

ingredients.name: Pork belly
ingredients.notes: you can substitute with pork shoulder or bacon

ingredients.name: Lacquer-glaze
ingredients.notes: available at Asian markets or online

instructions: In a large pot, combine the rice and 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
While the rice cooks, prepare the green chilli by cutting off the stems and removing the seeds.
In a separate pan, add the pork belly and cook over medium heat until browned and crispy.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
